text:
joanna: FYI incoming H100 pallet hit a customs exception in FRA, forwarder flagged a manifest mismatch — 4 units show no serials on paperwork. need triage. :eyes:

samir: ugh. which PO/vendor? can you drop the AWB and manifest snippet?

joanna: PO# RWI-4582, vendor: NovaCompute. AWB: `NLX987654321`. manifest excerpt:
```
Line 3: H100 x8 serials: [REDACTED]
Line 7: H100 x4 serials: MISSING
```
Customs wants evidence before release.

elliot: vendor quoted 6-8wk lead if we RMA/replace. do we have spare pool to cover this midwave? cost tradeoff vs expedited replacement from EU stockpile?

joanna: short on spares in EU region, can cover ~2 nodes from warm pool but still short 2.

alan-logistics: hey team — forwarding from NovaCompute. we received an amended manifest from the forwarder; looks like a packing label pull during consolidation removed serial stickers on that inner box. AWB shows split pickup across 2 hubs (AMS -> FRA). I've created RMA request with Nova (ref RMA-7641). Forwarder suggests partial release with holdback until depot photos uploaded.

samir: two options: 1) accept partial release, quarantine those 4 units, get depot photos + serial reconciliation and credit/replace later; 2) push Nova for immediate cross-dock from EU pool (expedite at vendor cost). which is lower friction?

elliot: vendor cost for cross-dock expedite = +€6k per unit. expected lead for vendor replacement = 6-8 weeks as I said. partial release + holdback likely cheaper but adds docketing/ops overhead and SLA risk. prefer partial release unless product-impact high.

joanna: app impact: we need these for a Dedicated cluster rollout next week in eu-central. missing 2 units will degrade throughput ~18% for that customer. ops will accept degraded SLO for a week if we can guarantee replacement timeline <3wks.

alan-logistics: Nova just replied: they can provide cross-dock from FRA pool with 5 business day ETA if we cover expedite fee (they'll waive 50% if we accept partial credit for the damage). They also requested depot photo proof within 48h for the holdback ones.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-227 — "Inbound manifest mismatch / serial loss" assigned to @samir, priority P2.

samir: i'm going to ping procurement to get signoff on expedite cost. @elliot can you confirm if we have budget wiggle for €12k expedite (2 units at €6k ea) or prefer to take the cheaper ops path?

elliot: pinged finance. tentative approve if vendor waives 50% and Nova provides shipping credit for the 4 held units. need formal quote.

joanna: ok let's do both in parallel: 1) ask FRA depot to partial-release 6 units and quarantine 2, take depot photos + serial scan; 2) procurement to accept expedited cross-dock for the 2 critical nodes if finance approves. alan, can you coordinate depot photos and uplift paperwork?

alan-logistics: will do. I'll post manifest scans and depot images here when available. also want to confirm RMA steps from Nova: they require depot photos + signed chain-of-custody, then issue replacement AWB within 48-72h after acceptance.

samir: thanks — keep thread updated. I'll wait for finance confirmation then confirm whether to accept expedite. :thumbsup:

joanna: thanks team, appreciate quick turnaround. once we have photos i'll file the customs release packet.

alan-logistics: posted depot photos and manifest patch: `https://files.redwood/vendornova/1769999991/photos.zip` — labels show abrasion on inner box. vendor accepted photo evidence and advanced RMA-7641 to approved.

ops-bot: Update: INC-2026-227 status changed to "triaged".
